reservedFontNameReview: The pinned OFL copyright header names The Inter Project Authors and does not specify a Reserved Font Name. Static instances retain the Inter family and preserve the full OFL license.

build.changes: Static optical-size14 instances of the upstream variable font. Conventional Inter family for Regular/Bold; legacy Inter Medium/Inter SemiBold family aliases expose exact500/600 weights to Tk. Preserve glyphs, copyright and license records.

isoInstallation: Four static weights in /usr/share/fonts/truetype/drivekey; Inter-OFL.txt and Inter-PROVENANCE.json in /usr/share/doc/drivekey-fonts; fc-cache -f at build time; no runtime downloads or font build dependency
